This looks like an 18Ni maraging steel (grade 350 type, with Ti 2.5 and Mo 2.2). I'm estimating from the grade, not looking up the recorded dataset value. Maraging steels of this type typically have yield strengths of about 2000–2400 MPa. For the 18Ni(350) grade the typical yield is about 2400 MPa, but this alloy has low Co and high Ti, so I'm estimating lower.
